categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two business segments: (1) Ozone system equipment manufacturing and sales, including ozone generators of various sizes and integrated ozone systems for water treatment, wastewater treatment, and flue gas treatment; (2) Chemical products manufacturing, specifically high-quality crystalline glyoxal and potassium formate produced through the proprietary 'ozone oxidation maleic anhydride method'. The company also has emerging segments in semiconductor-grade ozone equipment, health technology products, and new materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies include: (1) DTA non-glass discharge electrode technology for ozone generators; (2) Flat-plate ozone generation device technology; (3) Proprietary 'ozone oxidation maleic anhydride method' for producing high-quality crystalline glyoxal; (4) VPSA large-scale oxygen production technology; (5) High-concentration ozone water generation and detection technologies for semiconductor applications. Manufacturing employs make-to-order production with customization based on customer specifications, utilizing in-house production of key components and external sourcing for standard parts.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include municipal water treatment facilities, industrial wastewater treatment companies, petrochemical enterprises, pharmaceutical manufacturers, food and beverage companies, and environmental engineering firms. Key end markets are municipal water supply, municipal wastewater treatment, industrial wastewater treatment, flue gas denitrification, fine chemical synthesis, swimming pool disinfection, and semiconductor manufacturing. Major customers include large state-owned enterprises, municipal companies, and environmental protection listed companies.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in mainland China with headquarters in Qingdao, Shandong Province. Key operating locations include production facilities in Laixi and Qingdao. The company has expanded internationally with products exported to countries including Italy, United States, Australia, and South Korea. Domestic operations cover major regions with focus on municipal water treatment projects across China. A subsidiary operates in Xinjiang for chemical product manufacturing.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across multiple supply chain positions: (1) Midstream/downstream in the ozone equipment sector, manufacturing and integrating ozone systems for end-users; (2) Downstream in the chemical industry, producing glyoxal and potassium formate as intermediate chemicals for further processing by customers in pharmaceuticals, food, and specialty chemicals; (3) Upstream in semiconductor applications, supplying high-purity ozone equipment to semiconductor manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) Developing ultra-large ozone generators with 500kg/h capacity; (2) Advancing semiconductor-grade high-concentration ozone water and gas systems; (3) Expanding glyoxal production capacity and market penetration; (4) Developing health technology products including electrolyzed ozone generators and medical devices; (5) Pursuing digital transformation and intelligent manufacturing; (6) Expanding into new application fields including semiconductor cleaning and medical treatment; (7) Strengthening international market presence and import substitution.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue through: (1) Direct sales of ozone system equipment and generators to engineering companies and end-users; (2) Sales of chemical products (glyoxal and potassium formate) to downstream manufacturers; (3) Engineering services and system integration for ozone applications; (4) After-sales services including installation, commissioning, maintenance, and technical support. All sales employ direct sales model without distributors, with customized solutions provided to customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic ozone equipment manufacturer competing with international suppliers including Ozonia and WEDECO. Domestically, it holds a prominent market position with significant competitive advantages in large ozone system equipment. The company has achieved import substitution in high-end applications, with domestic equipment now replacing imported alternatives at 30-50% lower prices. The company is recognized as a national-level specialized and innovative 'little giant' enterprise and is listed among environmentally-compliant equipment manufacturers by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of December 31, 2023, the company reported total assets of 1.764 billion yuan and shareholders' equity of 1.239 billion yuan. 2023 revenue was 399.77 million yuan (up 36.61% year-over-year), though net profit declined to -29.14 million yuan from 18.01 million yuan in 2022, primarily due to losses in subsidiary companies and significant asset impairment provisions. The company has experienced growth in revenue but faced profitability challenges in 2023 due to expansion investments and subsidiary development costs.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's key differentiators include: (1) Advanced DTA non-glass discharge electrode technology enabling superior ozone generation efficiency; (2) Proprietary glyoxal production method producing high-purity products without impurities found in traditional processes; (3) Comprehensive technical expertise spanning ozone generation, system integration, and application engineering; (4) Proven track record with major customers including state-owned enterprises and municipal authorities; (5) Cost advantage over imported equipment while maintaining quality standards; (6) Integrated service model providing design, manufacturing, installation, and ongoing technical support; (7) Expanding into high-value semiconductor and medical applications with specialized equipment.
